verdict.rationale: The `config` command explicitly supports changing font, font size, background color, text color, and cursor color/shape (a-shell-gh-2), directly matching the story's customization request. However, there is no documented evidence that these settings persist across sessions/app restarts, and community feedback (unrelated HN comments) doesn't corroborate the persistence or usability of these settings. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that config changes persist across sessions, independent/hands-on corroboration of the customization workflow.
